integrity: Proof uses cyclotomic irreducibility and a necessary fourth residue moment; exhaustive finite checks are corroboration only. All standalone reproducibility dependencies are included.
scientific_limitations: Only balanced four-row subsets and paired-anchor four-column subsets of the Fourier matrix on Z_2 x F_p are classified. No general classification of 4x4 minors or sharp conditioning is asserted. Earlier equivalent literature remains a residual priority risk.
title: Exact rank and failure incidence for paired-anchor Fourier sampling on even semiprime cycles
